mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS department_id, d.name AS department_name, d.parent_id, COUNT(class_users.user_id) AS user_count, COALESCE(SUM(class_users.credit1), 0) AS total_credit FROM departments AS d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT root.id AS root_id, u.id AS user_id, u.credit1 FROM departments AS root INNER JOIN departments AS child ON child.id = root.id OR FIND_IN_SET(root.id, child.parent_chain) INNER JOIN user_department AS ud ON ud.dep_id = child.id INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.id = ud.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY root.id, u.id, u.credit1 ) AS class_users ON class_users.root_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.parent_id ORDER BY total_credit DESC, d.id ASC
